Minutes of City Council
MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF
THE CITY COUNCILOF THE CITY OF CALABASAS,
CALIFORNIA, HELD WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 08, 2010
OPENING MATTERS
Call to Order/Roll Call of Councilmembers
Pledge of Allegiance
The Star Spangled Banner performed by Carmen Reece
Approval of Agenda
ANNOUNCEMENTS/INTRODUCTIONS
Presentation to Julie & Lloyd Talbert and the Talbert Family Foundation.
Presentation to Barry Hammond and Dan Scully of Calabasas Park Homeowners Association.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - PUBLIC COMMENT
CONSENT ITEMS
1. Approval of meeting minutes from November 10, 2010 and November 24, 2010.
2. Recommendation to accept completion for the ADA Compliance - Citywide Sidewalk Ramp Improvement Project, Specification No. 09-10-04, by F S construction, and to direct the City Clerk to file notice of completion.
3. Authorization to execute a professional services agreement with Newbury Park Tree Service, Inc. for general tree work on City property and public streets, medians, and parkways.
5. Recommendation to (1) make permanent the Rental Assistance Program; (2) make permanent the temporary $50 increase to the monthly rental subsidy provided through the City’s Rental Assistance Program; (3) approve an expansion of the program from 45 to 50 people; and (4) direct the Chief Financial Officer to adjust the 2010-2011 Municipal Budget accordingly.
4. Adoption of Resolution No. 2010-1268, approving an updated and amended schedule of parking penalties and rescinding Resolution No. 99-583.
6. Update on the regulation of second-hand smoke in multi-family rental housing.
7. Updates on local and statewide efforts to ban the use of plastic grocery bags.
8. Check Register for the period of November 1, 2010 to November 23, 2010.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT
TASK FORCE REPORTS
FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - PUBLIC COMMENT
ADJOURN
Respectfully submitted:
Gwen Peirce
Assistant City Clerk
